question: Compare commit volume in ringi across months and explain the reasoning recorded at the peak.
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT year_month, commits AS commit_count
  FROM v_repo_activity
  WHERE repo_slug = 'ringi'
),
peak_month AS (
  SELECT year_month
  FROM monthly
  ORDER BY commit_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  m.year_month,
  m.commit_count,
  CASE WHEN m.year_month = p.year_month THEN string_agg(c.subject, ' | ') END AS peak_month_reasoning
FROM monthly m
CROSS JOIN peak_month p
LEFT JOIN v_commit c
  ON c.repo_slug = 'ringi'
  AND c.year_month = m.year_month
  AND m.year_month = p.year_month
GROUP BY m.year_month, m.commit_count, p.year_month
ORDER BY m.year_month
